scope: new independent Python verifier, replaying existing evidence only; no world runs
reference: frozen P01b pilot_reporting.verify and its frozen Python/Rust dependencies
candidate_design: one checked independent epoch replay producing verified activity alongside state; preserve full candidate, priority, conflict, parent, ledger, cap and detector checks

performance_inputs.selection: post-hoc engineering panel: spread across evaluated order plus known censored slow control; not a representative timing sample
performance_inputs.order: old then new for even panel index; new then old for odd panel index

gate.exact_outputs: all fixed inputs, including full detector records and censored endpoint policy
gate.tamper_rejections: all registered applicable corruptions; no accepted unaudited endpoints

interpretation: engineering equivalence and host-specific paired cost only; no claimed speedup before measurement or general tail bound
before_execution: freeze candidate/validator source and input hashes; retain failed attempts and every fixed pair
